media:group.media:title: i’m donating my planners.
media:group.media:description:
we had some extra 2026 doodle planners left, so this year we’re trying something a bit different! for every planner purchased during our second chance sale, we’ll be donating one to students, community programs,hospitals or organizations that support people getting back on their feet. if you’re a part of any organizations or have any that would appreciate our planner, please comment below! 🤍 We appreciate our community so much and want to spread the love you show us! even if you can’t purchase right now, sharing & interacting with this post would help a lot!
Planners are up to 50% off (depending on the color). Sale lasts until April 1st at 11:59pm. Note: if we aren’t able to find enough organizations that will accept our product donations, we will be donating the remaining equivalent value monetarily.
